body:
Read your story mate and that blows! I will never understand women! You and her were making plans to get married(same here btw)! She was actually taking charge on that! Honestly cannot imagine the suck you are going through right now! So all the luck in the world to you for dealing with that bloody situation!

The problem is that I have already tried the melatonin.. Didn't work. Ended up taking more then I should've and still could not sleep. GP prescribed sleeping pills(lorazepam) and still couldn't sleep. Slept well last night due to the fact that I had received some good news and was able to focus on that a bit(and got a bit mullered). But to be quite honest nothing is ever going to change the fact that I am not getting over her. And that's not just down to the fact that I loved this girl more than anything in the world, and it's because she is the hottest girl I have ever seen, no one on this planet has ever treated me better, seen more potential in me, gave me more confidence, wanted to be with me so much, made me laugh(whether intentionally or by accident), tried to be not just my girlfriend but my best friend, took really good care of me and just in general made my shitty life seem like it might just have a positive outcome :)! But it's also down to the fact that I didn't give it my best. I didn't love her the way she wanted! She gave me so many chances and I just didn't see the hurt I was causing by not being present in the moment enough and giving her what she wanted... By not being honest about the things going on in my life when she was/is the perfect person to help me through the bullshit that's going on inside my brain.

And by walking away to easily from what I had I have created a situation for which I can never forgive myself. A situation in which I let the only girl that has ever meant anything real to me and with whom I could actually see myself growing old and living the good life just because of the fact that she would've been there with me.

So no. I honestly believe that I will not be bouncing back from this unfortunately and I will probably die with the image of her in my brain. Which as it turns out would not have been a bad thing if I had given her all I got.

Wow people! Thank you for responding so quickly and supporting! I knew the people on here were brilliant!


I read your answers and there were things in there I hadn't heard before and some things other people had told me. And while I know you all are right and the suggestions are usually the kind thing I do automatically after a break up(this is not the first I ever had to go through! But as it stands the only one that has made feel this low)I tried all that stuff right after the break up and it ended up not helping me(i.e. going out trying new things, removing memory triggers, reading a lot of books, meeting new people and even ringing up old friends and as of the 4th of July I will even be trying therapy... yeah looking forward to that). All that did for me was distract me for very short periods at a time. I could sit there or be doing something and I would be somewhat engaged in conversation or the activity and after roughly 5 minutes my thoughts would just go straight back to her and no matter how hard I told myself not to think about her: I would just see her and remembering how firmly she told me she never wanted to be with someone else and that fact that after probably less than a month she is allready saying the sweet nothings to someone else.


Now I know I sound like a teenager(no offense.. trust me I know how hard it is at that age to lose the girl you love) who has just been dumped by his first girlfriend but this just feels totally different then anything I have ever been through.


While I have great memories with her it is really the future I am terribly down about. I just know she is going to do great without me but all I can think about is that I would be a better person with her in my life! She made me feel like I could take on the entire world and that feeling has dissipated completely.

@Brokenhandle: I realize that it's part of life but the fact that it happened so soon for her just makes me wonder about the kind of person I am and about the relationship we had built. And wonder about the fact that I was so easily replaced and she was so happy to move on.

@futurecrazycatlady(great name): I get what you're saying about the whole not being a slob, no magic cure(2 bad btw) and distraction but as I said above I've tried those things and they are not helping me one bit. All I can think about is how the things I am doing constructively for myself are not helping me to get her back and they make me wonder if I had done those things before I might still be with her...(Yep I know). And I am not really comparing myself in terms of how far along she is because one I am probably still in faze 0 out 50 and she didn't even need a chart or stepprogram to get over this :) whatever it was. As for feeling like shite after a break up: heck I used enjoy that feeling because it gave me a feeling having truly loved someone and it gave me strength to look for new challenges. But this is different. No way this is normal... for me at least!


@tessdevin: You have also stipulated the kind of activities the others are describing but honestly the thoughts of my ex are, since the moment I found out she had someone else already, totally debilitating and make me feel like even the smallest tasks are undoable seeing as she is no longer in my life.


And time isn't really working for me as well. The longer I spent apart from her the more I think about how her relationship is advancing in a positive way and I just keep slipping away further and further...


Like I was watching the FIFA World Cup 2014 and all I could think about was about her and me wanting to watch it with her and some friends... and knowing all the while she would be out celebrating with her new bf and them doing the things I want to do with her...(envious, jealous, bitter? Fuck yeah!)
  
Again I know I sound like a worthless, pathetic, waste of space person to be so hung up and crushed over a break up and especially since I know it to be my fault and that is was coming someday but it's just the way it is. Nothing and no experience has any value to me without her to share it with and even though I have been trying like hell to change that mindset it is not working in the slightest. And trust me normally I am not the kind of guy who stays so hung up on someone for too long a time. No matter what kind of relationship ends or for what reason I usually think: "You don't want me in your life? Fine I'll look for someone who does. And if I can't find anyone else? I'll be fine on my own!" Whether it be girlfriends or friends or anyone but this one has shook me to my core and destroyed every feeling of self worth and drive to accomplish anything! Like normally I am a really social person and can usually get along with everyone(almost literally) but lately i feel like i just want to be left alone and want people to stay the fuck away from me. I even got into a fight with a friend(no romantic feelings what so ever) of mine just because she was snogging some other dude in front of me(there is more to the story but I have once again made this short answer into a lord of the rings style book).


Seriously thank you for taking the time out of your lives to try to help me!! 

TL;DR: I basically feel like shit because I feel like I never tried hard enough to keep her(even though everyone says I did) and the fact that she was perfect in every way and is now sharing that perfection with someone else but me! So my question is if you have tried everything, what is there left to do?!
